name: Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995
department: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation, Ministry of Labour and Employment
target_group: Eligible EPFO members and pensionable employees under EPS rules
eligibility: Membership, service and pension conditions are governed by the EPS-1995 scheme and EPFO rules.
benefits: Pension and related benefits for eligible EPFO members, including superannuation and other categories under the scheme.
application_process: Use the EPFO member/employer process and official EPFO portal for claims and pension services.
